subject: en
source: English National Curriculum — English programmes of study: key stage 1 (Year 2 writing, vocabulary, grammar and punctuation; Appendix 2), DfE 2013

weeks.topic: Sentence boundaries: capital letters, full stops and question marks
objectives: Demarcate sentences with capital letters and full stops
Use question marks correctly

weeks.topic: Recount: my summer holiday
objectives: Write a recount in the past tense
Use time adverbials to order events

weeks.topic: Four sentence types
objectives: Identify statements, questions, exclamations and commands
Write one of each type

weeks.topic: Expanded noun phrases
objectives: Use adjectives to describe and specify nouns (the blue butterfly)
Write noun phrases in sentences

weeks.topic: Stories with familiar settings: planning a narrative
objectives: Plan a story set somewhere familiar
Describe the setting with noun phrases

weeks.topic: Coordination: and, but, or
objectives: Join clauses using and, but and or
Write compound sentences

weeks.topic: Commas in lists
objectives: Use commas to separate items in a list
Write lists in sentences

weeks.topic: Instructions: how to grow a bean
objectives: Write instructions using commands
Use time adverbials and numbered steps

weeks.topic: Poetry: shape poems and calligrams
objectives: Write a poem in the shape of its subject
Choose interesting words to describe it

weeks.topic: Subordination: because, when, if, that
objectives: Extend sentences using because, when, if and that
Explain reasons with because

weeks.topic: Non-chronological report: animals of the Amazon
objectives: Organise facts into sections with headings
Use present tense and technical words

weeks.topic: Letter writing: writing to a character
objectives: Write a letter with a greeting and sign-off
Ask and answer questions in the letter

weeks.topic: Handwriting: diagonal joins
objectives: Start to use diagonal joining strokes
Keep letters a consistent size

weeks.topic: Traditional tales from other cultures: retelling with a twist
objectives: Retell a tale from another culture
Change one part of the story

weeks.topic: Review: sentence types, conjunctions and noun phrases
objectives: Revisit the four sentence types
Practise coordination and subordination
Write noun phrases

weeks.topic: Apostrophes for contracted forms
objectives: Use apostrophes in contractions (can't, didn't, I'm)
Expand contractions to their full form

weeks.topic: Present and past tense, including progressive
objectives: Use present and past tense correctly and consistently
Use the progressive form (is running, was running)

weeks.topic: Noun suffixes -ness and -er; compound nouns
objectives: Form nouns with -ness and -er
Make compound nouns (whiteboard, superman)

weeks.topic: Adjective suffixes -ful and -less; -er and -est
objectives: Form adjectives with -ful and -less
Compare using -er and -est

weeks.topic: Adverbs with -ly
objectives: Turn adjectives into adverbs with -ly
Use adverbs to describe how an action happens

weeks.topic: Stories by significant authors: Roald Dahl
objectives: Explore characters in The Enormous Crocodile
Write a new episode in the same style

weeks.topic: Explanation text: how a caterpillar becomes a butterfly
objectives: Explain a process in order
Use time words and present tense

weeks.topic: Writing about real events: the Great Fire of London
objectives: Write a diary as someone in 1666
Use past tense and feelings

weeks.topic: Newspaper report: retelling a real event
objectives: Write a headline and the who, what, where, when
Report events in the past tense

weeks.topic: Poetry: performing with intonation and actions
objectives: Learn a poem and perform it with expression
Use intonation to make meaning clear

weeks.topic: Proofreading for spelling, grammar and punctuation
objectives: Check writing for spelling mistakes
Correct punctuation and verb tense

weeks.topic: Mid-year writing assessment
objectives: Write a narrative using expanded noun phrases and conjunctions
Use sentence punctuation and commas in lists

weeks.topic: Apostrophes for singular possession
objectives: Use apostrophes to show possession (the girl's book)
Tell possession apart from plurals

weeks.topic: Persuasive writing: a poster for a school event
objectives: Use persuasive language and exclamations
Organise information on a poster

weeks.topic: Fantasy stories: inventing a new world and character
objectives: Create a fantasy setting and character
Describe them with noun phrases and adverbs

weeks.topic: Information booklet: features of non-fiction
objectives: Use contents, headings, captions and a glossary
Write a booklet on a topic

weeks.topic: Planning writing: notes, key words and new vocabulary
objectives: Plan ideas by writing notes and key words
Collect new vocabulary before writing

weeks.topic: Grammar terms: noun, verb, adjective, adverb, tense
objectives: Identify nouns, verbs, adjectives and adverbs
Use the terms tense, apostrophe and comma

weeks.topic: Evaluating and editing writing with a partner
objectives: Discuss what works well in a partner's writing
Make simple improvements to my own writing

weeks.topic: Extended writing: an adventure story
objectives: Write an adventure story with a clear beginning, middle and end
Use a range of sentence types and conjunctions

weeks.topic: End-of-year writing assessment
objectives: Write a narrative and a non-fiction text
Use Year 2 punctuation and grammar accurately

weeks.topic: Year 2 review: ready for Year 3
objectives: Revisit apostrophes, suffixes and sentence types
Share my best writing of the year
